config.model_digest_note: The tag alone is not a pin. `qwen3:latest` is whatever the registry calls latest on the day you pull, so until 2026-09-23 this 'fixed configuration' would have run a different model under the same manifest after any upstream re-tag, and nothing would have noticed. run_eval.py now refuses to start if the local digest differs, and every journal records the digest it actually ran against.
config.seed_note: Deliberately unfixed. At temperature 0.2 a pinned seed would make the three repeats near-copies and the repeat count would measure nothing. Unfixed, the three runs measure run-to-run variation under one configuration, which is what repeats are for.
config.think_note: think:false is a measured choice, not a default, and the measurement is weaker than the first probe suggested. See proofs/config_selection.json. At num_predict=400 reasoning on returned content:'' twice out of two: the whole budget went to the reasoning channel and the reply carried no action. At num_predict=2400 it returned content:'' once out of three and a usable action the other two times, taking 54-123s. think:false returned a usable action three times out of three in under a second. So the case for it is latency plus instability, not a categorical failure.
